pure-announcement.rationale: Reference or research material, not an announcement.

duplicate.rationale: No graph-propagation retrieval concept exists; the retrieval ADR names this as a bake-off candidate with no backing note.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Published, cited material; claims checkable at the linked source.

durability.rationale: A decades-old associative-search method — seed labeling, weighted decaying propagation, termination on path convergence — with roots in cognitive psychology and a documented IR application.

actionability.rationale: The mechanism is described operationally: seeds, weights, decay, marker passing; enough to implement a bounded variant.
